Jamun Powder Price — High-Quality Spray Dried Jamun Powder for Global Industries

Are you looking for a reliable jamun powder supplier to elevate your product formulations? Tradenest Naturals offers premium spray dried jamun powder, processed with advanced technology to retain maximum nutritional value and natural color. Because we use sophisticated spray drying techniques, our powder maintains the authentic essence of the black plum. Therefore, it is an ideal ingredient for the nutraceutical and food industries.

Why Choose Our Spray Dried Black Plum Powder?

Our manufacturing process focuses on precision. First, we select only the finest, ripe black plums. Next, we extract the pure juice. Finally, we use spray drying to convert this liquid into a fine, highly soluble powder. This method ensures that the bioactive compounds remain intact. As a result, you receive a nutraceutical grade jamun powder that meets strict international standards. Moreover, our powder offers superior solubility compared to traditional drum-dried alternatives.

Manufacturing Excellence and Quality Control

At Tradenest Naturals, we prioritize consistency. We operate a state-of-the-art facility designed for high-volume production. Our team monitors every batch to ensure it meets your specific technical requirements. In addition, we implement rigorous microbial testing. This ensures that every shipment is safe and pure. We understand that jamun powder price is a key factor for your business. Consequently, we optimize our supply chain to offer competitive wholesale rates without compromising on quality.

Versatile Applications in Food and Health

Our wholesale spray dried jamun powder serves a wide range of sectors. For instance, beverage manufacturers use it to create functional health drinks. Similarly, the nutraceutical industry incorporates it into dietary supplements and capsules. Because of its fine mesh, it blends seamlessly into powders, yogurts, and confectionery products. If you are looking for a bulk jamun powder manufacturer, we provide the scalability your brand needs.

Detailed Product Specifications

We provide complete transparency regarding our technical data. Our typical specifications include a fine mesh size for easy dispersion. We also maintain low moisture levels to prevent clumping. Below are the standard parameters for our spray-dried product:
  • Mesh Size: 80-100 Mesh for optimal solubility.
  • Moisture Content: Less than 5% to ensure stability.
  • Purity: 100% pure fruit extract, no additives.
  • Solubility: High solubility in water and functional liquids.
